requirements.criterion: Fidelidad visual comparada con las capturas canónicas.

evidence.reason: La equivalencia visual requiere juicio humano contra las capturas aprobadas.

requirements.criterion: URL compartible abre el producto correcto.

evidence.test: a shared link opens the product, survives a reload, and closing returns to its card

requirements.criterion: Cierre restaura scroll y foco del disparador.

evidence.test: opening from a card and going Back closes it and restores scroll and focus

requirements.criterion: Lector de pantalla anuncia título, precio, controles y stock.

evidence.test: sold-out products are shown, labelled and cannot be added
a populated drawer and checkout stay accessible and announce cart changes

evidence.reason: El orden y la comprensión del anuncio requieren una pasada con lector de pantalla real.

requirements.criterion: Cerrado permite navegar y conservar carrito pero bloquea pedidos.

evidence.test: store cannot receive an order from the app, but the menu and cart keep working

requirements.criterion: Delivery fee se aplica exactamente una vez.

evidence.test: charges the fixed fee once for delivery and nothing for pickup

requirements.criterion: Tests cubren fechas límite y cruce de medianoche.

evidence.test: keeps a shift open after midnight and closes it at the next-day boundary
opens exactly at the opening time, not a millisecond before

requirements.criterion: No existen zonas de delivery no solicitadas.

evidence.reason: Es una restricción negativa de alcance que se confirma revisando las superficies públicas y Admin.

requirements.criterion: Dos promociones elegibles nunca se acumulan.

evidence.test: applies only the highest-priority eligible promotion; discounts never stack

requirements.criterion: Calendario, prioridad, pausa y manipulación están cubiertos.

evidence.test: is in effect from startsAt (inclusive) until endsAt (exclusive)
never applies a paused promotion, even when it would be the best one

requirements.criterion: No hay cupos o límites automáticos por unidades.

evidence.test: has no quotas or per-unit caps: the same promotion covers every eligible unit

requirements.criterion: La UI explica la promoción con precios derivados.

evidence.test: explains the promotion from its mechanic, never from admin free text
the struck price, the promotion note and the applied promotion meet WCAG AA

requirements.criterion: El total se recalcula en servidor.

evidence.test: recomputes the total on the server and builds the owner's wa.me link from it

requirements.criterion: Local cerrado o carrito inválido no confirman.

evidence.test: gives no link when the server refuses the order

requirements.criterion: WhatsApp nunca acredita un pago.

evidence.test: keeps notes on one line, so they cannot forge a total or payment line

requirements.criterion: Copy, encoding y ARS sin decimales están cubiertos.

evidence.test: encodes the text for wa.me with the store number as digits only
formats ARS without decimals and with thousands separators

requirements.criterion: Anon y usuario sin membresía son rechazados.

evidence.test: login is private and direct anonymous admin access returns to it
rejects a signed-in user without an active membership as unauthorized

requirements.criterion: No se autoriza con user_metadata o sólo cliente.

evidence.test: gets the current admin through getUser and the membership gate without metadata

requirements.criterion: No hay open redirects ni Admin offline.

evidence.test: offline, Admin and pages never visited show the public offline page, not cached content
invalid credentials reveal neither account existence nor a redirect target

requirements.criterion: Sesión expirada y acceso cruzado están cubiertos.

evidence.test: rejects an expired session as unauthorized
rejects an active membership belonging to another store

requirements.criterion: No se publica configuración inválida.

evidence.test: keeps an incomplete product as a draft

requirements.criterion: Upload falso, excesivo o SVG se rechaza server-side.

evidence.test: rejects SVG, GIF, HEIC and text
enforces 5 MiB on the raw size before looking at the content

requirements.criterion: Escrituras requieren admin real y dan feedback.

evidence.test: takes the store from the membership, never from the form
the owner manages the catalog by product type and a fake image is rejected server-side

requirements.criterion: No aparecen pedidos, facturación ni KPIs.

evidence.test: links to the catalog and the public menu without invented metrics

requirements.criterion: Secretos no llegan a HTML, logs o respuestas Admin.

evidence.test: never puts server secrets in the HTML

requirements.criterion: Habilitar pedidos exige tarifa válida.

evidence.test: refuses %s without a delivery fee

requirements.criterion: Promociones se previsualizan con precios derivados.

evidence.test: changing the percentage changes the prices

requirements.criterion: La carta pública sigue accesible para admin.

evidence.test: the owner sees store and promotion settings without secrets, and the same public menu

requirements.criterion: El navegador no envía precios confiables.

evidence.test: calcula autoritativamente con la base de datos sin recibir precios del navegador

requirements.criterion: Sin keys no aparece MP ni se carga SDK.

evidence.test: hides Mercado Pago when the store has not enabled it

requirements.criterion: Sandbox cubre aprobado, pendiente, rechazado y abandono.

evidence.reason: Los estados externos y el abandono requieren credenciales y pagos sandbox reales.

requirements.criterion: El retorno no acredita por parámetros del navegador.

evidence.test: TC-ZERO-TRUST: nunca acredita por parámetros de URL arbitrarios sin validación con MP

requirements.criterion: Webhook repetido no duplica efectos.

evidence.test: replay: the same notification again is a duplicate and has no effect

requirements.criterion: Mismatch no acredita.

evidence.test: credits nothing without an attempt, in another currency or for another amount

requirements.criterion: Pago sin WhatsApp queda registrado sin tablero.

evidence.test: approves the attempt from the payment read in the API, keeping the contact, without anyone returning

requirements.criterion: Replay, firma, carrera y purga están cubiertos.

evidence.test: rejects another secret
race: two deliveries of the same notification at once apply it once
the purge removes the expired quote, attempt and event

requirements.criterion: Playwright reconoce la PWA instalable.

evidence.test: the menu is installable: manifest, icons and a controlling worker

requirements.criterion: Admin y checkout no se sirven desde caché.

evidence.test: the worker stores the public menu and assets, never admin, APIs or RSC payloads

requirements.criterion: Actualización no mezcla shell y assets.

evidence.test: offers an installed update and activates it only when accepted, then reloads

requirements.criterion: Offline permite ver caché pero no enviar o pagar.

evidence.test: offline the cached menu opens and the cart works, but nothing can be sent or paid

requirements.criterion: GitHub y Vercel bloquean regresiones críticas.

evidence.reason: Branch protection y la integración Vercel son configuración externa al repositorio.

requirements.criterion: Los selectores son accesibles y estables.

evidence.test: keyboard users can skip to content and operate overlays

requirements.criterion: Fallos adjuntan screenshots y traces.

evidence.reason: La retención se demuestra provocando un fallo controlado y revisando el artifact del runner.

requirements.criterion: Cada caso queda mapeado o justificado manualmente.

evidence.test: keeps every BB-07 through BB-17 requirement mapped to resolvable evidence
one orderable product of every public type reaches the same cart
a populated drawer and checkout stay accessible and announce cart changes
